text: Cicero tied living and thinking together.
Not just having thoughts, but noticing them.
Much of the day runs on autopilot:
the same phrases, the same reactions.
Inner speech is where autopilot lives.
Listening to it is the first step
is a thought you can question.
what did I just tell myself?
What is your inner voice saying right now?
This is the thread behind the book *The Science of Learning Your Inner Speech*.
Hearing the voice, then guiding it.

text: “Doubt is not a pleasant condition, but certainty is absurd.”
Voltaire saw it the other way:
certainty is the thing to be wary of.
Today, pick one belief and ask:
What are you too certain about?
This is the thread behind the book *Learn To Think For Yourself*.
A practical path to your own conclusions.
